title: UI source
description: One shadcn registry item as the site serves it, and whether its code is exposed.

source.description: The item URL or file the caller passed.

exposed.description: True when files is non-empty and every file carries its content.

item.description: The registry item JSON, untouched. shadcn's registry-item schema defines the rest. Null when the site answers HTTP 401 for the item, as Kobra does for a Pro item.

cacheHit.description: Always false. An item is read fresh on every call.
